feeds.title: Soundtracks, Scores and More!
feeds.description: Soundtracks, Scores, and More is presented by Lakeshore Records, passionate fans of film music, soundtracks, score recordings, and more in all formats, media, and genres!

feeds.title: John Williams Fan Network
feeds.description: John Williams news, discussion, articles, reviews, analyses, and much more! Mr. Williams has composed the music and served as a music director for more than one hundred films, including, War of the Worlds, Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith, Harry Potter, and the Prisoner of Azkaban, and more.

feeds.title: Scoring Sessions
feeds.description: ScoringSessions.com is the top Internet archive of Hollywood film, television, and video game scoring session photography. Dan Goldwasser was Editor-in-Chief for the acclaimed website SoundtrackNet for over ten years. During that time, he attended scoring sessions for such notable composers as Jerry Goldsmith, Elmer Bernstein, Michael Kamen, and more eventually, he began covering the sessions for SoundtrackNet.

feeds.title: Movie Music UK
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jonathan Broxton. I've always been interested in film music, for as long as I can remember. And here I share my film score reviews.

feeds.title: Soundtrack Heaven
feeds.description: For movie soundtrack enthusiasts and music aficionados, a collection of rare, hard to find, out-of-print, lost, forgotten, and classic movie soundtracks.

feeds.title: Film Music Notes Blog
feeds.description: I'm Mark. I worked as a Professor of Music Theory for several years in universities, specializing in film music, Beethoven, and rock music in my teaching and research. For more than two decades, I have taught music theory and analysis to all ages and at all levels from the community music school to the large university. My focus now is on developing online courses on the analysis and composition of film music, right here on Film Music Notes!

feeds.title: Film Music Central
feeds.description: Hello everyone! I'm Becky (I also go by Bex), I am 32 years old and I have a PhD. in Musicology, specializing in film music. Since I specialize in film music, this blog mostly features articles on the music in films, though I will also write about films in general, feature composer interviews, or sometimes random film-related things.

feeds.title: Side One Track One
feeds.description: Side One Track One is a music and film blog based in Austin, Texas. It was brought into the world by John Laird on August 9, 2006.

feeds.title: Filmstro Blog
feeds.description: Advice, insight, inspiration, and how-to guides from the best and brightest. We want to help you improve your film and video production. We are a music technology startup from Brighton, UK, giving you the power to create professional soundtracks.

feeds.title: Bear McCreary Blog
feeds.description: Based in Los Angeles, California, Bear McCreary is an American musician and composer of film, television, and video games scores.
